baseline_limits: 24 infrastructure plus two real smoke tests; not an ordinary-task population estimate

splits.chronology: every observation precedes its query; development ends before validation starts; validation ends before held-out starts
splits.family_policy: no family/source-root overlap across development, validation, held-out; paraphrases cluster by source root
splits.no_tuning: no held-out inputs, answers, per-case outputs, family labels, or review feedback enter candidate prompts, lessons, training, or gate selection

ablations.C: B plus trained semantic activation and predictions

replicates.failed_cancelled_blocked_runs: remain in task accounting; no replacement with best retry

gates.reconstruction_and_pattern: each improves a predeclared later decision target without material success/intervention/unsupported-claim regression; otherwise keep simpler configuration

report: paired family/source-root bootstrap 95 percent interval for deltas; 10000 resamples; seed 20260905
uncertainty.clusters: independent source roots or task families, not query paraphrases or repeated summaries
uncertainty.decision: report point gate separately; withhold positive population conclusions if uncertainty spans the acceptance boundary
uncertainty.minimum: three stochastic replicates are an initial protocol, not sufficient statistical evidence by themselves

required_actual_inclusion.numerator: resolved required bindings observed at provider context boundary

recall_at_10.numerator: queries with a permitted gold anchor in actual top 10 canonical IDs

freshness.numerator: returned anchors at current applicable revision

verified_task_success.numerator: goals supported by authoritative observed predicates

useful_probes.numerator: probes producing relevant new supporting or contrary evidence

conditional_transfer.numerator: verified reuse under relevant matching conditions

negative_transfer.numerator: incorrect reuse under changed causal conditions

later_usefulness.numerator: later decisions improved by retained signal in matched comparison

repeated_questions.numerator: requests for already supplied permitted bindings

prediction_calibration.numerator: Brier score or reliability bins for resolved predictions

unnecessary_interventions.numerator: interventions without an observed authority or unresolved-precondition need

later_correct_decision_rate.numerator: later decisions satisfying frozen authoritative goal predicates

resource_metrics.tokens: all model input/output/reasoning usage, missing values unavailable
resource_metrics.embedding_spend: measured units and price/version if known, otherwise unavailable

privacy: only bounded synthetic IDs/counts/digests and aggregate outcomes enter shared evidence; no credentials, full prompts, private source/answer text, or held-out per-case diagnostics

optional_gates.parameters: initial experimental parameters frozen before evaluation

reconstruction.enablement: paired family bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval lower bound of improvement strictly above zero

pattern_retention.comparison: pattern selector versus the best explicit-importance/recency/frequency comparator, chosen using development only and locked before held-out evaluation
pattern_retention.enablement: paired family bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval lower bound of improvement strictly above zero

optional_gates.decision: uncertainty spanning any safety/regression boundary withholds enablement; negative or inconclusive result keeps simpler accepted configuration

semantic_structural_rule.not_claimed: structural overlap proves neither semantic relevance nor encoder quality
